aim: Test whether one homogeneous Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process shared by all traits and families can generate the empirical AusTraits log(K) family repeatability and trait rank predictive gains, conditional on exact observed system trees.

OU_process.stochastic_dynamics: dX = alpha(theta - X) dt + sigma dW, with theta=0 and sigma2=1 identical for all families and traits in each scenario.
OU_process.ancestral_state: Stationary N(theta, sigma2/(2*alpha)) at each independently simulated exact system-tree root.
OU_process.absolute_time_scale: Tree edge-length units from the pinned source-native GBOTB.extended.TPL; alpha is constant across ALL 254 systems in a given scenario.
OU_process.reference_time: T_ref = median of each exact system tree's maximum root-to-tip depth across all 254 fixed systems, computed before simulating outcomes.
OU_process.absolute_alpha_per_scenario: alpha = c / T_ref for c in [0.25,1,4]. No alpha is chosen after comparing to empirical K.
OU_process.implementation: Use exact reassembled source-native trees and a fast O(n_edges) K evaluator validated against the original frozen phytools K estimates; no outcome-based system filtering.
OU_process.simulation_loop: For each branch l, child = exp(-alpha*l)*parent + sqrt((1-exp(-2alpha*l))/(2alpha))*N(0,1).

predeclared_outputs: Matched-graph LOFO absolute log(K) prediction gain
Matched-graph LOFO within-family rank prediction gain
K family conditional repeatability after named-trait fixed effects
Cross-family pair-order reversal for trait pairs shared by at least 10 families

decision.conservative: If ANY of the 3 homogeneous-OU scenarios accommodates the observed K family and trait-rank effects, do not claim these effects require trait-/lineage-specific evolutionary-process parameters.
decision.evidence_beyond_grid: Only if the empirical effects exceed the upper 97.5% null quantile for both family repeatability and rank predictive gain on BOTH tree axes for ALL 3 scenarios, describe them as beyond the pre-frozen set of homogeneous OU alternatives.
decision.boundary: This does not exclude other untested homogeneous processes, trait covariance or measurement/source biases.
